description: This file defines an abstract base class for audio mixers used in output transport modules. It establishes the interface for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and mixing audio data, to be implemented by concrete subclasses.

classes.name: BaseAudioMixer
classes.description: An abstract base class for output transport audio mixers, providing methods for initialization, cleanup, processing control frames, and mixing audio.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the mixer when the output transport starts, given the sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up the mixer when the output transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: MixerControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes a mixer control frame received from the transport.

methods.name: bytes mix(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes incoming transport audio bytes with the mixer-generated audio.

ctags.name: mix
ctags.pattern: /^    async def mix(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
